comment: The DURATION mapping is 0.001 * 10000 raised to the knob position, so 1ms to 10 seconds (src/widgets/StageCurve.hpp:37-39). Synced, the knob snaps to one of seventeen ratios from 1/16 to 16 beats (src/widgets/StageCurve.hpp:42-53). The curve formula is taken from DHE Modules' sigmoid curve under the MIT licence, credited in the file header; positive curvature gives a slow start. The chain is rescanned every sample and stops at the first module to the right that is not an F (src/MADREPEATER.cpp:149-166). The host writes the expanders' two output jacks itself (src/MADREPEATER.cpp:289-295). The panel prints LEVEL over the pair of level knobs, then START, END, CURVE, DURATION, LOOP, SYNC, MANUAL, TRIGGER and OUT. Lettering is drawn in code at src/MADREPEATER.cpp:333-371.
